purpose: English chapters with a Spanish appendix.
why: Language handling in cleanup, chunking and retrieval (questions in both languages).

blocks.text: The queue depth of component Q001 is 85 megabytes. The setting is validated before the service accepts traffic. Operators usually leave it unchanged unless the workload grows.
The heap ceiling of component X002 is 46 records. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart. It is documented here because several teams depend on it.
The batch limit of component Z003 is 3 connections. The setting is validated before the service accepts traffic. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment.
The queue depth of component W004 is 76 attempts. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment. Operators usually leave it unchanged unless the workload grows.
The cache ttl of component V005 is 88 seconds. It is documented here because several teams depend on it. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment.
The retry budget of component K006 is 80 connections. Operators usually leave it unchanged unless the workload grows. It is documented here because several teams depend on it.
El profundidad de cola del componente Q007 es 31 intentos. Este valor se lee al arrancar y puede cambiarse por entorno. Normalmente no se modifica salvo que crezca la carga.
El límite de reintentos del componente X008 es 67 segundos. Normalmente no se modifica salvo que crezca la carga. La configuración se valida antes de aceptar tráfico.
El límite de reintentos del componente Z009 es 68 segundos. La configuración se valida antes de aceptar tráfico. Normalmente no se modifica salvo que crezca la carga.
